concerns.text: FR-001 requires extracting compositions for FIVE specific ternary systems (Fe-Cr-Mo, Fe-Cr-V, Fe-Mo-V, Fe-Cr-W, Fe-Mo-W). Task T048-Orchestrate mentions iterating through 'all required ternary systems' but does not explicitly list these five systems or ensure T048-Exec covers all of them. If the loop is incomplete, FR-001 is not satisfied.

SC-003 requires measuring deviation against experimental literature values (APT). Tasks T095c-Exec and T095e-Exec allow the pipeline to 'fail silently' or generate a fallback report if APT data is missing, rather than enforcing a hard fail or a mandatory amendment process to satisfy the 'mandatory success criterion' defined in the spec. There is no task to formally amend the spec or halt the project if SC-003 cannot be met, leaving the criterion untestable.

SC-004 requires measuring the percentage of alloy systems where non-linear thresholds are identified. Tasks T022-Exec-Synth and T023-Exec-Synth perform these checks on SYNTHETIC data. There is no corresponding task to execute the MSE reduction and significance tests on the SCIENTIFIC (real) data to satisfy SC-004's requirement for 'published evidence' in the actual materials.

FR-002 mandates computing segregation energies using Quantum ESPRESSO. While T017b creates an amendment, there is no task to formally update `spec.md` or record the amendment in the project state to satisfy Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline). The spec file remains unchanged while the implementation diverges.

Task T013 description claims to load 'REAL DFT segregation energies' but the dependency chain (T045f-Fetch/T045f-Gen) allows for a fallback placeholder with 'MISSING_SOURCE' flags. The description contradicts the implementation plan which explicitly allows bypassing real physics with synthetic/missing data.
